sentences.text: Parvigrus pohli was a chicken-sized bird related to cranes and limpkins.
The genus Parvigrus was established by Mayr in 2005 and contains only the species Parvigrus pohli, which is the sole member of the family Parvigruidae.
The specific name pohli honors Burkhard Pohl, who obtained the specimen for the Wyoming Dinosaur Center.
Fossils of Parvigrus pohli were discovered in Vachères, France.
The fossils of Parvigrus pohli come from Lower Oligocene rocks.
Parvigrus lived between 33.9 and 27.3 million years ago during the Rupelian stage.
